messages:
Sarah M: Heads up — launching the paid search + retarget stack for the Apr 3 webinar. Need creative refresh, landing A/B, and a clear inbound lead routing plan. Who can own pacing?

Tom B: I can take pacing. Proposal: $150/day start on search (broad + branded split), scale to $300/day on day 3 if CTR > 1.5% and CPL < $40. Retarget pool: 7/14/30 day buckets with decreasing bid multipliers.

Jen O: I'll do UTMs and SFDC mapping. Routing: webinar leads -> Campaign: Webinar_Apr3 queue, SDR queue for MQLs, auto-tag utm_campaign=webinar_apr3. Quick question: do we want lead scoring threshold at 50 to push to SDRs?

Sarah M: Yes set threshold 50 for SDR. Low-score leads still get nurture drip. Also want frequency cap on retargeting to 6 views/week.

Ash P: Creative note — refresh headline and CTA. Current best performers: "Ship LLM features faster" and "Reduce token cost by 30%". For this webinar test, let's run 3 variants: product-led, cost-savings, and case-study angle.

Tom B: Agreed. I'll run ad copy A/B with final url to two landing variants. Pacing rules: 
```
search: daily_budget = 150, bid_strategy = tCPA target 8.00
retarget: dynamic bids, multiplier 1.2/1.0/0.7 for 7/14/30d
scale_rule: if 3-day CPL < 35 && CTR > 1.5% then budget *= 2
```

Marcos (campaign-bot): Reminder — creative asset deadline in 48 hours. Uploads: hero image, 3 headlines, 3 descriptions, tracking pixel snippet.

Jen O: Routing note — SFDC field mapping: source/medium -> utm_source/utm_medium, campaign -> utm_campaign, campaign_variant -> utm_content. I’ll push leadflow tests to staging at 11am PT.

Sarah M: One blocker: last webinar had a mismatch where retarget leads were double-counted due to cross-domain cookies. Ash, can you confirm GA4 event + server-side ping?

Ash P: On it. I'll add server-side event forwarder and set dedupe on client event id. Also adding a hidden field on the form: first_click_id to help attribution.

Tom B: Quick ask for reporting: need hourly burn dashboard and conversion funnel for first 72 hours. Can someone add a cost-per-signup widget to the marketing dashboard?

Jen O: I’ll add CPL and signups widget. Also wiring SFDC campaign sync for conversion timestamp.

Sarah M: Cool. Action items: Tom — pacing + ad launches, Ash — pixel + dedupe, Jen — UTMs + SFDC routing, Marcos — asset reminders. Check-in tomorrow 10am PT to confirm creatives uploaded. :rocket:

Tom B: Launch checklist I’ll post in channel when ready. Will tag @here before turning on traffic.

Marcos (campaign-bot): Scheduled: creative-deadline reminder in 36 hours.

Jen O: Found small typo in landing copy — fixed. Uploading variant B now.

Ash P: Server-forwarder deployed to staging, dedupe test passed.

Tom B: All set from my side — starting slow roll tomorrow morning 9am PT. Will monitor pacing and pause if CPL spikes > 70.

Sarah M: Thanks team. Keep updates short in this thread. If any immediate production issues, move to #release-war-room.
